meta.title: Regretted line items are clearly marked

plan.title: Regretted line marker in technical submission

steps.note: Open an existing event with a closed technical stage and a vendor response awaiting evaluation.
Navigate to the Technical Stage where the evaluator reviews the vendor submission.

args.goal: as the evaluator, open the vendor's Technical Stage submission and verify that the regretted line item is visibly marked as regretted; stop on the submission view showing the marker

steps.note: The catalog has no narrower domain assertion for the evaluator's regret marker, so inspect the submission directly in the current session.
Assert that the visible regret marker is present on the submission.
